title: Propulsion Assignment
description: Study and analyze rocket propulsion systems, including chemical and electric propulsion methods. Calculate thrust, specific impulse, and efficiency parameters.

title: Combustion Analysis
description: Analyze combustion processes in rocket engines and calculate efficiency parameters. Focus on temperature, pressure, and chemical reaction kinetics.

title: Nozzle Design Project
description: Design and optimize rocket nozzle geometry for maximum thrust efficiency. Use computational fluid dynamics to validate your design.

title: Aerodynamics Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of aerodynamic principles and flow dynamics. Covers subsonic and supersonic flow regimes.

title: Flow Analysis
description: Analyze fluid flow patterns and calculate pressure distributions around various aerospace vehicle geometries.

title: Heating Analysis
description: Study thermal effects and heat transfer in aerospace applications. Include convective, conductive, and radiative heat transfer.

title: Structural Design Task
description: Design structural components for spacecraft and analyze stress distributions under various loading conditions.

title: Orbital Calculations
description: Calculate orbital mechanics parameters including velocity, period, and trajectory for various mission scenarios.

title: Systems Engineering Exam
description: Comprehensive exam covering systems engineering principles and methodologies. Includes project management and risk analysis.
